chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawah narrated to me from his uncle Muhammad ibn Abi al-Qasim, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Ubayd ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali, from al-Husayn, from his father, from his grandfather, who said:
Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'Adorn yourselves with the Yemeni stone (for rings), for it repels the deceit of the stubborn/devilish Shayatin.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (Title of Imam Ali)
key_terms.الْجَزْعِ الْيَمَانِيِّ: The Yemeni stone/gem (specific material for rings)
key_terms.مَرَدِهِ: Stubbornness / Defiance (often referring to the nature of Shayatin)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of wearing a ring made from Jaz' al-Yamani according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Thawab al-A'mal*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) prescribes wearing a ring of *Jaz' al-Yamani* to ward off the subtle deceptions (*kayd*) of the devils, reflecting the Shia tradition of using physical amulets (*tamim*) for spiritual protection. This practice underscores the belief in the tangible efficacy of blessed objects in combating unseen spiritual forces, a concept deeply rooted in both Quranic verses and Prophetic tradition.
